privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Tutorly is the platform your center uses to manage lessons, bookings, and evaluations - it doesn't collect consent on its own.
privacy.acceptedTitle: Where your privacy consent was given
privacy.acceptedDesc: The privacy policy governing your personal data was presented and accepted in person when you enrolled at your tutoring center, before any account on this platform was created.
privacy.reviewDesc: You can review the full privacy policy at any time on your center's own website, or by requesting a copy directly from the center - in person, by phone, or by email.
privacy.questionsDesc: For any question about how your data is used or to exercise your rights (access, correction, deletion), contact your center directly - they are the data controller, not this platform.

cookies.heading: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Tutorly uses only the cookies strictly necessary to keep you signed in. We don't use third-party cookies, advertising cookies, or any cookie that tracks you across other sites or collects analytics about you.
cookies.sessionCookiePurpose: Keeps you signed in between page loads (identifies your session on our server).
cookies.noThirdPartyDesc: This cookie is set by Tutorly itself and sent only to Tutorly - never to an advertiser, analytics provider, or any other third party.
cookies.noTrackingDesc: It contains only a random session identifier, no personal data, and isn't used to track you across other websites or build a profile of your activity.
cookies.essentialDesc: Because it's required to keep you logged in, this cookie can't be turned off from within the app. If you prefer not to use it, you can disable cookies in your browser, but you won't be able to stay signed in.
cookies.otherStorageDesc: The light/dark theme preference (see the toggle in the header) is saved in your browser's local storage, not a cookie - it stays on your device and is never sent to our server.
